question: Which of the following is NOT a classical dance form of South India?
solution:
Correct answer is __**Sattriya.**__

__***Key Points__**

__
 
• Sattriya or Sattriya Nritya, is **a major Indian classical dance**. 
 
• It is a dance-**drama performance art.**
 
• origins in the Krishna-centered** Vaishnavism monasteries of Assam, **and **attributed to the 15th century** **Bhakti movement scholar and saint Mahapurush Srimanta Sankardev**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​Mohiniyattam's roots, like all **classical Indian dances**, are in the **Natya Shastra* .**
 
• Bharatanatyam ** is used to express Hindu religious stories and devotions**.
 
• **Kathakali** is a major form of classical Indian dance.
